description: This file defines a React functional component 'Navbar' for a Next.js application. It renders a responsive navigation bar with links to 'Dashboard' and 'Settings', and a logout button. The component uses hooks for routing and authentication.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if a given path is currently active based on the current pathname.

methods.name: linkClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class string for a navigation link, highlighting it if active.
